title: T4-T8 EZ after rib cage removal with 400 N follower load (Mannen 2018)
subcategory: rib cage removal with follower load

quantity.name: EZ
quantity.definition: elastic zone (NZ end to max load)

source.authors: Mannen EM, Friis EA, Sis HL, Wong BM, Cadel ES, Anderson DE
source.journal: J Mech Behav Biomed Mater 84:258-264 (author manuscript)
source.sample: 8 fresh-frozen human T1-T12 thoracic spines, tested with intact rib cage and after rib cage removal (same specimens as Sis 2016 / Anderson 2016)

protocol.summary: T1-T12, T1/T12 potted; 400 N follower load (cables through ball-joint rods in vertebral bodies T3-T11); pure moment +/-5 Nm at T1, 1 deg/s, 5 cycles, 3rd analysed; tested with rib cage intact (data = Sis 2016 400 N) and after removal of the entire rib cage. Optotrak pins at T1, T4, T8 (T12 potted).
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T12 ligamentous spine WITHOUT rib cage; fix T12
Apply 400 N follower load along the spinal curvature (T1-T11), then pure moments +/-5 Nm at T1 in LB, FE, AR
Report rotation between the tracked vertebrae of the region
protocol.notes: Only the rib-cage-removed condition is written here: the intact-rib-cage values in Table 1/2 are the same data as Sis 2016 400 N regional values (identical except Lower LB ROM 5.14 vs 5.07 and Lower AR ROM 12.16 vs 12.2).

extraction.check_notes: Re-read from text layer; significance marks stripped.

ribcage.intact_structures: none (entire rib cage removed; ligamentous T1-T12 spine)

loading.device: Applied Test Systems spine tester, Optotrak

sequence: rib cage intact (= Sis 2016 400 N data)
